title: Oh la saria da ridere
subtitle: Don Alfonso and Despina: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 13, recitative after No. 17
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Despina's a sognarsi coll' aria (the libretto has lagnarsi), Don Alfonso's funciulla (fanciulla), partiti (partite), queste tue bestioline (due) and attendandomi (attendendo mi); macchina (machina), puo without its accent, quì, gioja, perchè, purchè, un' amante, and coll' aria and cos' è as two words.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 144–147, the recitative between No. 17 and No. 18 (65 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 144–145 and 146–147), then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Two bars are printed a sixteenth short and are filled out: Despina's last note in bar 10 (“coll'”) and Don Alfonso's “que-” in bar 45 are written as eighths. It ends “segue Nr. 18 Finale”. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 99, from Jacobs (2:37).
